comments.label: episode Title
comments.text: Make this episode title card: 1) more apparent, by using the yellow treatment we applied to an expanded row on the dynamic table (i.e. highlighted yellow background, gold vertical edge on the lefthand side); and 2) in light text add a preposition and then the period information ("in late 2017", "from early to late 2020", etc.) on its own line.

comments.label: e001Pair Sticky
comments.text: There should only be one sticky banner. This banner should also get the highlighted yellow row treatment, but in a miniature form. Only use the dropdown treatment for cases in which there's more than one target or more than one chaser.

comments.label: sat Meta A
comments.text: I think you can reduce the tabbed distance between the field names in Satellite Details and Orbit Detail and the field entries.

comments.label: speed Chart
comments.text: Can you please double check the math behind the relative velocity (and tell me about it in the chat)? Consider the tail-end of E-008 when the Russian satellite retreats (and therefore grows the separation distance), but then appears to reenter basically the same orbit, but in a different phase, shouldn't the relative velocity then fall? But it doesn't.

comments.label: 3D globe
comments.text: I'm noticing that when a reference orbit from the 3D globe approaches the control panel, it ends. Instead, the reference orbit should disappear only when it actually goes behind the control panel.

comments.label: separation Chart
comments.text: When the dynamic charts' data labels are referencing a valuable that's very close to the selected threshold, the entirety of the little threshold line that's supposed to extend to the threshold data label disappears. Instead, I want as much of it as possible to stay. To solve this, I think you just need to shrink the white background behind the prinipal data label to the width of the data label string.

comments.label: playback Dock
comments.text: The chapter toggle should have the same left and right margin as other rounded-corner cards in the control panel; i.e. skinnier than what I see now on E-001.

comments.label: speed Up Btn
comments.text: All episodes should play from the earliest chapter moment upon load.

comments.label: dwell Stat
comments.text: There's a big distance between "20h" and "21 min" when such a value is displayed for the dwell time. Decrease that distance; shorten "min" to "m"

comments.label: 3D globe
comments.text: The sequence for "Loading episode" should look more like the sequence for changing from chapter to chapter: it should be on a white background, not a warm off-white one.

comments.label: playbackDock
comments.text: When there's not enough real estate to fit a chapter's name on one line, you have to shrink the size of the text.

comments.label: E-059 · source 0
comments.text: You can do a better job printing the page and showing what that webpage looks like for the freatured image.

comments.label: E-059 mini visualization
comments.text: The loading episode indicator should be in the center _of the mini preview pane_ meaning centered under the right-most six columns width wise and the height of the description + action link + blank space below that height wise.
